notes: AYFXTWN - XFX MODE, IDM drums. Every key from C2 to C7 is its own snappy drum voice: the keys climb through kicks, snares, claps and hats, tuned percussion and glitch bursts, and each key has its own pitch, tight decay, level, pan and amp-envelope REPEAT count (1-8 extra hits while held, a few keys roll continuously). Hold a key for a stutter roll; tap it for a one-shot. Built from the synthesized drum set, which loads with the preset.
